name: financial-services
one_liner: A ready-made pack of AI assistants for finance jobs like building pitch decks, checking company earnings, and reconciling accounting records, that a finance team can install and start using right away.
buyer: A boutique investment bank or private equity associate's manager who wants junior-analyst-style work (comps, memos, reconciliations) drafted faster without hiring more analysts.
business_use_cases: A boutique advisory firm installs the Pitch Agent to draft comps, precedents, and an LBO into a branded deck before a client meeting, then has an analyst review it.
A small fund's back office uses the GL Reconciler and Month-End Closer agents to catch reconciliation breaks faster during monthly close.
A wealth management shop uses the Meeting Prep Agent to auto-build a briefing pack ahead of every client call.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'set up and customize these financial agents for your firm' implementation service to boutique funds and advisory shops.
Build and sell a niche add-on agent (e.g. for a specific regulatory filing type) tailored to a vertical this pack doesn't cover.

steal_this: Install the Market Researcher agent, run it against a niche sector nobody else is covering, and sell the resulting research note to a handful of independent investors this weekend.
